in_sanskrit.name: Bahuguna
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Blessed with many virtues
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Bahuguna एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Bahuguna is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘bahu’ meaning many and ‘gun’ meaning virtues. This name is bestowed upon a child believed to be blessed with numerous virtues and qualities.
